summary: iFacto, a Business Central partner, describes how the ReSkill program helped it hire consultants from non-traditional backgrounds, such as warehouse management and supply chain. It is a short partner testimonial from the BCTalent Stories series, published 2024-04-26.
overview:
In this two-minute BCTalent story, iFacto explains its business focus and how it used the ReSkill program to recruit new Business Central consultants. The program found candidates the partner says it could not have found on its own, because it looked in other areas than the partner normally would.

The video covers which skills new consultants need, including BC product knowledge, AI, business intelligence, Power Apps and consulting skills. iFacto says the people hired through the program are enthusiastic, eager to learn and were rapidly integrated into the team, and it recommends the program to other partners.
key_points: The ReSkill program helps BC partners find candidates without Dynamics experience but with solid business experience, for example in warehouse management or supply chain.
iFacto says the program found people it could not have found itself, because it was searching in other areas.
Skills named for new consultants: BC product knowledge, AI, business intelligence, Power Apps, plus consulting skills beyond product knowledge.
iFacto describes its hires from the program as enthusiastic, eager to learn and quickly integrated into the team.
iFacto recommends the program to other partners.
